in_marathi.name: Janmesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Janmesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Janmesh is derived from two words - 'Janma' meaning birth and 'Ish' meaning God. It signifies God's gift, emphasizing the divine intervention in one's life.
